# dash0_eval (Resource)

Manages a Dash0 generative AI evaluation (eval). An eval sends a sample of the GenAI spans that match its filters to an LLM judge, which scores each span with the eval's prompts.

~> **Note:** `metadata.name` and the kind of `spec.judge.output` cannot change after create, because eval results are stored under the name and per output kind. Changing either destroys the eval and creates a new one, and the new eval starts with no results.

`metadata.name` must be unique within the dataset, and `spec.match.filters` must contain an `is_set` filter on `gen_ai.operation.name` without values. Deletes are soft: a destroyed eval stops judging spans, and the API keeps a tombstone of it. Changing `dataset` destroys the eval and re-creates it under a new origin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dash0_eval" "answer_relevance" {
  dataset   = "default"
  eval_yaml = file("${path.module}/eval.yaml")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `eval_yaml` (String) The eval definition in YAML format. The YAML must declare `kind: Dash0GenerativeAiEvaluation`, `metadata.name`, an explicit `spec.enabled`, and `spec.display`, `spec.match`, `spec.sample` and `spec.judge`. The `dash0.com/folder-path` and `dash0.com/sharing` metadata annotations are supported, and changes to them trigger a resource update; `dash0.com/sharing` has no effect on access. The server-managed `metadata.labels` and `metadata.annotations` are ignored, and any other label or annotation is rejected, because the Dash0 API would drop it.

### Optional

- `dataset` (String) The identifier of the [Dash0 dataset](https://dash0.com/docs/dash0/miscellaneous/glossary/datasets) that the eval belongs to. Provide the dataset's identifier, which is immutable, not the 'name'. If omitted, the provider-level `dataset` default is used (see the provider's `dataset` attribute). Changing this value forces the resource to be recreated under a new origin.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The server-assigned identifier of the eval, resolved by the provider after creation.
- `origin` (String) A unique identifier for the eval, automatically generated on creation. Used to reference the eval for updates, reads, deletes, and imports.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
terraform import dash0_eval.answer_relevance default,tf_existing-evaluation-origin
```
